nodes.label: ADR 0010: SaaS Tier Shape — Hybrid Quantitative Limits + Feature Flags
nodes.rationale: Hybrid model: each tier (Basic/Professional/Enterprise) defines both quantitative resource limits (orgs, locations, members, customers, monthlyTxns) and binary feature flags (ghl, commissionSplits, memberships, apiAccess). Single source of truth in packages/types/src/tiers.ts TIER_LIMITS. Application fee is tier-driven (3%/2%/1.5%) stored as applicationFeeBps. Feature gates: requireTierFeature middleware (TIER_FEATURE_LOCKED). Quant limits: assertWithinLimit at write time (TIER_LIMIT_REACHED). Soft cap on downgrade.
alternatives_rejected: Pure quantitative limits (inflexible for capability features)
Pure feature flags (loses upsell for high-volume tenants)
Defer tier enforcement to v2 (pricing page lacks credibility)
